title: Master List of 2027 Social Media Holidays
curation_rule: Only moments with a social movement behind them: a named organiser, real public participation for 3+ years, a clear ask, observed in SG, PH, AU, NZ or US.

left_out.Sensitive days: World Suicide Prevention Day, R U OK? Day, World AIDS Day, International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women, remembrance and memorial days. These matter, but brand content around them can hurt people. Support quietly, if at all.
left_out.Brand-founded or commercial days: Small Business Saturday (started by American Express), Black Friday, Cyber Monday, 11.11 (Singles' Day), Prime Day. Plan these as sales moments if you sell, but they aren't movements.
left_out.Novelty days: National Donut Day, Talk Like a Pirate Day and the like. Fun, but no movement and no ask.
left_out.Public and religious holidays: Lunar New Year, Hari Raya, Deepavali, Christmas, Waitangi Day, Thanksgiving and the rest. Mavic's Calendar shows public holidays for each country in its Holidays panel.

holidays.name: Dry January
holidays.join_only_if: you offer alcohol-free options or support people taking part
angles: Your alcohol-free menu or range
Social plans that don't need a drink
Week-by-week check-ins
holidays.risk: Alcohol brands should sit this out. No health claims.

holidays.name: Veganuary
holidays.fit: Food and drink, F&B, grocery, wellness
holidays.join_only_if: you sell or make plant-based products, or your team is genuinely taking part
angles: Your best plant-based picks, honestly labelled
One simple swap a day for a week
A team member's Veganuary diary
holidays.risk: No health claims you can't prove. Don't call a product vegan unless it is.

holidays.name: International Day of Education
holidays.join_only_if: you teach, fund learning or make learning tools
angles: A free lesson or resource from your team
The teacher who changed your founder's path
How your product helps someone learn
holidays.risk: Avoid making it a sales post.

holidays.name: Black History Month (US)
holidays.organiser: Theme set by ASALH, the Association for the Study of African American Life and History
holidays.ask: Learn, celebrate and support Black communities
holidays.fit: Any US brand with a genuine connection: founders, partners, community work
holidays.join_only_if: you can show real support beyond February: partners, suppliers, giving, people
angles: Spotlight a Black-owned partner or supplier, with their consent
Share what you're reading or funding
Hand the mic to someone from your community
holidays.risk: Tokenism backfires. No logo-only posts. Watch the US political climate and keep the focus on people.

holidays.name: Safer Internet Day
holidays.organiser: Insafe network for the European Commission, with national centres such as eSafety (AU) and Netsafe (NZ)
holidays.cause: A safer, better internet, especially for young people
holidays.ask: Learn and share online safety habits
holidays.join_only_if: you build or run something people use online
angles: Three settings every parent should know in your app
How you protect customer data, in plain words
A myth-buster on online scams
holidays.risk: Don't overstate your security. Point to official guidance.

holidays.name: Zero Discrimination Day
holidays.cause: Equality before the law and in practice
holidays.fit: Employers, HR and people brands, inclusive brands
holidays.join_only_if: your policies back up what you post
angles: A policy you changed and why
What inclusion looks like in your hiring
A customer story about access
holidays.risk: Words without policies read as empty.

holidays.name: World Wildlife Day
holidays.join_only_if: you work with or near nature, or fund conservation
angles: A local species your customers can spot
How you reduce your impact on habitats
A partner conservation project
holidays.risk: Avoid claims of impact you can't measure.

holidays.name: Clean Up Australia Day
holidays.date_note: Community clean-ups Sun 7 Mar; organiser events also on 2 and 5 Mar
holidays.ask: Register or join a local clean-up
holidays.join_only_if: your team will actually turn up and clean up
angles: Invite customers to your team's clean-up
Before and after photos of your site
What you found and what you'll change
holidays.risk: Show the work, not the logo.
holidays.date_display: Sun 7 Mar 2027 (Community clean-ups Sun 7 Mar; organiser events also on 2 and 5 Mar)

holidays.name: International Women's Day
holidays.organiser: United Nations (UN Women), with the internationalwomensday.com campaign
holidays.ask: Celebrate women and act for equality
holidays.fit: Any brand that can show real action
holidays.join_only_if: you can show women in your business, customers or supply chain, and what you're doing for equality
angles: Women on your team in their own words
A number you're working to change (pay gap, promotions)
Women-led partners or suppliers
holidays.risk: Quote cards without action get called out. Check claims about pay and representation.

holidays.name: Earth Hour
holidays.ask: Switch off non-essential lights for an hour
holidays.join_only_if: you will actually switch off (signs, stores, office) and can show it
angles: Your shopfront going dark at 8:30 pm
What your team does in the dark hour
One change you're keeping after the hour
holidays.risk: Switching off for an hour isn't a climate strategy. Say what else you do.
holidays.date_display: Sat 20 Mar 2027 (Organiser date: 8:30 pm local time)

holidays.name: International Day of Happiness
holidays.organiser: United Nations, with Action for Happiness
holidays.cause: Wellbeing and happiness as a goal
holidays.ask: Do one thing that makes someone happier
holidays.join_only_if: you can add something useful, not just a smile
angles: One small habit your team swears by
A customer moment that made your day
An act of kindness you'll do today
holidays.risk: Avoid mental health claims.

holidays.name: World Water Day
holidays.join_only_if: water use is part of your business
angles: How much water your product or kitchen uses, and how you cut it
A tip customers can try at home
A partner water project
holidays.risk: Back water-saving claims with numbers.

holidays.name: World Health Day
holidays.ask: Take one step for your health or others'
holidays.join_only_if: you have a health role and can stay within regulated claims
angles: Your team's lunchtime walk
A myth your industry gets asked about, answered
How you support staff health
holidays.risk: Health claims are regulated. Stay general and point to official advice.

holidays.name: Earth Day
holidays.cause: Environmental protection. 2027 theme: Food for Our Planet (plant-based diets and food labels)
holidays.ask: Take one action for the planet, this year on food
holidays.join_only_if: you can point to a real change in how you source, make or package
angles: One change you made this year, with the number
A plant-forward dish or product, honestly labelled
What your customers can do with leftovers or packaging
holidays.risk: Greenwashing. Every green claim needs proof.

holidays.name: Fashion Revolution Week
holidays.date_note: Week around 24 April; 2027 dates TBC by the organiser
holidays.cause: A fair, transparent fashion industry; marks the Rana Plaza collapse (24 Apr 2013)
holidays.join_only_if: you can answer who made your clothes, by name or by factory
angles: Meet the people who make your product
Your supplier list, or your plan to publish it
A mending or rewear tip
holidays.risk: If you can't answer the question, don't ask it. Dates for 2027 not yet announced; the UK HQ closed in 2026 and the movement now runs through its global network.
holidays.date_display: Sat 24 Apr 2027 (Week around 24 April; 2027 dates TBC by the organiser)

holidays.name: Mental Health Awareness Month (US)
holidays.cause: Mental health awareness and access to care
holidays.ask: Talk about it, check in, find support
holidays.join_only_if: you support, not sell: you have a policy, a resource or a partner to share
angles: What your team does to switch off
How you support staff mental health
Where to find help (link official services)
holidays.risk: Support, don't sell. No therapeutic claims. Always link official services.

holidays.name: World Bee Day
holidays.fit: Food, honey, gardens, cosmetics with bee ingredients
holidays.join_only_if: your product or place depends on pollinators
angles: How many of your ingredients rely on pollinators
A bee-friendly planting tip
A local beekeeper you work with
holidays.risk: Avoid claims of 'saving the bees'.

holidays.name: International Day for Biological Diversity
holidays.ask: Learn about and protect local nature
holidays.join_only_if: your business touches land, sea or supply chains in nature
angles: A local plant or animal near your business
How you source responsibly
A partner restoration project
holidays.risk: Back claims with specifics.

holidays.name: World No Tobacco Day
holidays.join_only_if: you have a health or workplace role
angles: How you support staff who want to quit
Official quit resources
Smoke-free spaces you run
holidays.risk: Stay with official health guidance.

holidays.name: Pride Month
holidays.organiser: Local Pride organisations (major events in some markets fall in other months)
holidays.ask: Celebrate, support and show up for LGBTQ+ people
holidays.markets: US, PH, NZ, SG (community events), AU (major events in Feb and Mar)
holidays.join_only_if: you support LGBTQ+ people all year: policies, partners, giving, people
angles: Your team's own voices, with consent
A community partner and what you fund
Your policies, in plain words
holidays.risk: Rainbow-washing gets called out. Check local rules and norms for each market before you post.

holidays.name: World Environment Day
holidays.cause: Environmental action; 2027 host Serbia, theme Play for Humanity: Sport and Music for All
holidays.ask: Take part in the year's campaign
holidays.join_only_if: you can show a change you've made
angles: This year's theme, applied to your business
A measured change
An action customers can take
holidays.risk: Tie your post to the 2027 theme only if you have a real link to it.

holidays.name: World Oceans Day
holidays.join_only_if: your business touches the sea, seafood or plastic
angles: Where your seafood comes from
A beach clean you'll join
Plastic you've cut
holidays.risk: Seafood sourcing claims need certification.

holidays.name: World Refugee Day
holidays.fit: Employers, food (refugee cooks and makers), social enterprises
holidays.join_only_if: you employ, partner with or fund refugee-led work
angles: A colleague's story, told by them, with consent
A refugee-led partner
What you fund and why
holidays.risk: Never use people's stories without consent. Keep it about people, not politics.

holidays.name: Dry July
holidays.cause: Raising funds for people affected by cancer by going alcohol-free
holidays.ask: Go alcohol-free for July and raise funds
holidays.join_only_if: your team or venue takes part or offers alcohol-free options
angles: Your team's fundraising page and progress
Your alcohol-free menu
Social plans without a drink
holidays.risk: Alcohol brands should sit this out. Be exact about where funds go.

holidays.name: Plastic Free July
holidays.ask: Choose to refuse single-use plastic for July
holidays.join_only_if: you've cut plastic or offer a real alternative
angles: Packaging you've removed, with the number
A refill or bring-your-own offer
Customer swaps that stuck
holidays.risk: 'Plastic-free' claims must be true for the whole product and pack.

holidays.name: NAIDOC Week
holidays.date_note: First Sunday in July to the following Sunday (preliminary)
holidays.cause: Celebrating the history, culture and achievements of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples
holidays.join_only_if: you have a genuine relationship with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people or organisations
angles: A local event your team attends
An Indigenous-owned partner, with consent
What your team learned
holidays.risk: Follow NAIDOC's guidelines on the theme and logo. Never use cultural material without permission. Dates are preliminary.
holidays.date_display: Sun 4 Jul to Sun 11 Jul 2027 (First Sunday in July to the following Sunday (preliminary))

holidays.name: Earth Overshoot Day
holidays.date_note: Announced around June; in 2026 it fell on 30 July
holidays.ask: Help move the date back with practical solutions
holidays.join_only_if: you can show a solution that uses fewer resources
angles: One solution from your business and what it saves
What #MoveTheDate means for your industry
A customer action that helps

holidays.date_display: Date announced each year (Announced around June; in 2026 it fell on 30 July)

holidays.name: International Youth Day
holidays.join_only_if: you hire, train or serve young people

What young customers taught you

holidays.name: International Day of Charity

How customers can join in
Your team's volunteering hours

holidays.join_only_if: you make, sell or support reading

A tip for raising readers

holidays.name: World Cleanup Day

holidays.type: Day (events often on the weekend before)
holidays.organiser: UN (UN-Habitat facilitates), with the Let's Do It World movement
holidays.fit: Retail, F&B, packaging, local businesses, teams
holidays.join_only_if: your team will take part
angles: Your team's clean-up, in photos
What you collected and what it taught you
Invite customers to join

holidays.date_display: Mon 20 Sep 2027 (UN day 20 Sep (resolution 78/122); many clean-ups run Sat 18 or Sun 19 Sep)

holidays.name: International Day of Peace

angles: A community project you support

holidays.organiser: Breast cancer charities in each market (for example the National Breast Cancer Foundation in Australia)
holidays.cause: Breast cancer awareness, screening and research

A free resource for teachers

holidays.organiser: World Federation for Mental Health (UN observance)

holidays.cause: Food security and better food systems

A food bank you support

holidays.name: International Day for the Eradication of Poverty

Fair pay in your supply chain

holidays.name: Movember

Your supplier code, in plain words
A partner you support
